reason: A browser UI plugin that replaces the default token statistics line with a theme-adaptive visual bar and details panel for token usage, context composition, cache metrics, throughput, latency, and session statistics.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中以可视化状态栏和详情面板展示会话 Token、上下文占用、缓存、吞吐量及首字延迟。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that visualizes session token usage, context occupancy, cache metrics, throughput, and first-token latency in a status bar and details panel.

capabilities: Displays token usage and context occupancy metrics in a web UI
Visualizes input, output, cache, throughput, latency, and session statistics
Provides a clickable details panel with contextual breakdowns
Adapts presentation to light and dark themes and supports Chinese and English
